messages:
jordan: hi all, starting my first week and hitting a wall with observability access. followed the onboarding doc but i cant see the Prod Grafana folder and datadog shows no monitors. also Sentry invite never arrived. any quick triage steps?

maria: welcome @jordan! quick checklist: 1) confirm your company email in the access form; 2) we provision groups via Okta team assignments, so if your role/group isn't synced you get 403s; 3) Datadog requires a separate request with your manager CC'd. did you pick 'Observability - Prod' on the form?

jordan: yes i picked Prod. i can access staging dashboards but prod is 403.

kevin: prod Grafana lives under the folder /Prod > Overview and uses folder-level permissions. if you can see staging but not prod it's almost certainly an SSO-group issue. i've seen a delay ~15-30 mins after Okta group add.

samir: fwiw Sentry invites sometimes get filtered by our email provider if the invite is from a no-reply address. check spam and company filters. if still not there i can trigger a resend from the Sentry org console (ping me).

jordan: checked spam, nothing. is there a way to confirm my Okta groups?

maria: yes: go to https://okta.redwood.com/me and look under 'Groups'. you should see `redwood-observability-prod` and `redwood-grafana-read`. if not, DM me your manager + team and i'll kick the sync.

obs-bot: OBSERVABILITY BOT: logged access request OBS-5578 for user jordan. Status: pending.
